name: guildproof
description: A guild of specialist agents, and an inspector that can stop the job. /sharpen turns a rough request into a complete prompt that names its assumptions instead of guessing. /lens reviews through expert lenses, or grades a prompt PASS/WEAK/FAIL with --grade. /forge-agent writes a reusable agent prompt. /orchestrate splits a multi-domain build across a 20-agent gallery and runs an independent verifier that can halt it. Eval-backed, including six known-bad fixtures the suite must always fail. Zero dependencies, no API keys, model-agnostic.
